title: Pocketwire Rewards Boost Allowances by Tier
content:
Each Pocketwire Rewards tier sets how many boost offers can be open at once, how many purchases one activation boosts, the most boost points on one purchase, how long an unused boost stays valid and how long a freed slot waits before a new boost can be activated in it.

| Tier | Open boosts at the same time | Qualifying purchases per activation | Most boost points on one purchase | Validity of an unused boost (calendar days after activation) | Swap cooldown (full hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1 | 1 | 500 | 7 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 1 | 1 | 750 | 7 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 1 | 1 | 1000 | 14 | 12 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 2 | 1 | 1500 | 14 | 12 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 2 | 2 | 2000 | 30 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 3 | 2 | 3000 | 30 | 0 |

## Column definitions

- Open boosts at the same time: the maximum number of boost offers activated and not yet used or expired at the same time.
- Qualifying purchases per activation: the number of qualifying purchases one boost activation applies to.
- Most boost points on one purchase: the maximum boost points on one purchase.
- Validity of an unused boost: the calendar days after activation that an unused boost stays valid.
- Swap cooldown: the full hours after a boost is used or expires before a new boost can be activated in that slot. A cooldown of 0 hours means the slot can take a new boost as soon as it is freed.

## Tier notes

- Member, Silver and Gold are single-slot tiers: one open boost at a time. Platinum and Diamond allow two, Obsidian three.
- On Diamond and Obsidian one activation applies to 2 qualifying purchases; on the other tiers to 1.
